annotations.title: Get the text of an interpellation

description: Get the text of an interpellation (interpelacja) or of a reply to it, as plain text.

num.description: Number of the interpellation: the `num` field from get-interpellations

replyKey.description: Key of a reply (replies[].key from get-interpellation); omit to get the interpellation itself. A reply with onlyAttachment=true has its content only in the attached PDF

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-interpellation-text
title: Get the text of an interpellation
